name: Olugbenga Agboola
script: Yeah that's us. Look, let me just tell you everything so you don't have to drag it out of me. We do payments infrastructure for Africa, cross-border, merchants plug in once and take cards, mobile money, bank transfers across like thirty-plus countries. We're headquartered in San Francisco but honestly most of the team sits in Lagos. We're way past seed, we've done a Series D. There were three co-founders originally, I'm the CEO. Team is north of a thousand people. We're looking at a new round, roughly two hundred and fifty million dollars, equity.
Wait, correction, only two of the founders are still full time, not three.
Oh sure, because you totally know payments better than me.
What do investors usually expect at this stage anyway?
Use whatever website you found online, it's the obvious one.
Skip the pilots thing, that's not relevant for us.

byStep.F1.stage: Series D and beyond, so later stage.
byStep.F1.description: Payments infrastructure for Africa: one integration for cards, mobile money and bank transfers across more than thirty countries.
byStep.F1.country: United States, San Francisco, though most of the team is in Nigeria.
byStep.F2.materials: We have a deck and audited financials.
byStep.F4.founder_count: three founded it, two still full time
byStep.F4.full_time: Not all of them, one left.
byStep.F4.functions: product, engineering, sales and partnerships, operations, finance
byStep.F5.signal: we have lots of paying customers, that's not early signal territory
byStep.F6.use_of_funds: expansion into new markets and product
